|errata_history=This is the original printed state of the card, titled •BoShek's Modified Light Freighter. The later version [[Infinity]] (PC-E1, the current card) is titled •Infinity with the same game text. The release-sheet slip on this page prints •BoShek's Modified Light Freighter; the Master List slip and the Players Committee card image print •Infinity (see [[Infinity]]).
* '''Original''' (this page): titled “•BoShek's Modified Light Freighter” (lore “Modern Corellian design. Length 100 meters. Features engine system similar to that of a Corellian corvette. Dorsal hatch reveals hangar bay.”) on the Virtual Block 4 release sheet, slip 109E: “May add 2 pilots. While BoShek piloting: maneuver and hyperspeed +2; immune to attrition < 4; and if at a battleground system, may add 1 to Force drains here.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=12 Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 12, slip 109E. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=12 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-109E-Infinity.png]]) prints it. The PC website card list still showed the card under this title from 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013.<ref name="cl-1240_112-old">Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001437/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111144021/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive; the same in the VMasterType list): “BoShek's Modified Light Freighter”</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Infinity]]): On 29 January 2013 the [[Players Committee]] announced the persona-name change “BoShek’s Modified Light Freighter ---> Infinity”, effective immediately (old slips stayed tournament-legal; non-gameplay lore was removed; “Each of the cards will retain their gametext and characteristics”)<ref name="persona2013">[https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 New Persona Changes], [[Players Committee]], 29 January 2013. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 Internet Archive].</ref>. The PC website card list shows the new title by 15 March 2013 (the last capture with the old title is of 11 January 2013)<ref name="cl-1240_112-new">Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20130315122117/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2013-03-15] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130429051930/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2013-04-29] (Internet Archive): “Infinity” (these captures carry no game text)</ref>, and the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 50) prints the card as “•Infinity” (no lore)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=50, page 50. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=50 Internet Archive]</ref>: “May add 2 pilots. While BoShek piloting: maneuver and hyperspeed +2; immune to attrition < 4; and if at a battleground system, may add 1 to Force drains here.” The game text did not change. The Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1240-112-front-master.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-L-infinity-pre.gif]]) print it.
